text: 4. **Privacy at the type level** — fact payloads carry event ids, op ids, amounts-by-unit, and canonical mint URLs only when already public via `kind:10019`; never proofs or secrets. Bake it into the types, not a display-edge filter. [...] Net design in one line: **`nmp-wallet` owns an event-sourced, confluent reducer; state is the fold, the causal trail is a bounded in-memory ring + a per-atom cause index over the same facts, the saga feeds facts in as a producer, and `kind:7376` is the durable tier — all separate from the money-safety journal's persisted at-most-once records.**
